findings.summary: Too many look-alike tracks (143, same names across companies); reader almost gave up.
Fees shown only as small percents with no shekel amount, so they seem negligible.
Many rows show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return, preventing comparison.
Reader didn't understand the exposure circles and FX percent; guessed at the colours.
Two fee types (from savings / from deposits) and reader didn't know which matters.
Returns are shown before management fees, so not what the reader would actually get.
No guidance on next steps or how to open the fund.
'Not yet reported' with orange warning icon put reader off one row.
